    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TermsAgreement" name="Agreement on terms" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Event_TermsAgreed" messageRef="Message_TermsAgreement"/>

      </bpmn:lane>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueRFP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvaluateProposals</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalAssessment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductSiteVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AssessmentMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_TermsAgreed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostSigningSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OnboardSupplier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExecuteContract</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostSigningJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_SupplierOnboardedAndContractExecuted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive proposal responses" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" name="Conduct an additional assessment?" default="Flow_AssessmentSkip"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSiteVisit" name="Conduct site visit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductInterview" name="Interview suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_TermsAgreed" name="Both parties agree on terms">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_TermsAgreed" messageRef="Message_TermsAgreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostSigningSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Officially onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostSigningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupplierOnboardedAndContractExecuted" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">siteVisitSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interview" name="Interview" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentSkip" name="No additional assessment" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisitToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
